name: claude-image-paste-bracketed
description: Paste clipboard images into a Claude Code terminal over Remote-SSH so Claude renders them inline as [Image N] — via bracketed-paste injection, the way cmux does it.
author: Benjamin Wood

commands.title: Claude: Paste Clipboard Image to Terminal
Claude: Smart Paste (image or text) to Terminal

claudeImagePaste.imageDirectory.description: Workspace-relative directory where pasted images are written (created on demand, on the remote when using Remote-SSH).

enumDescriptions: Inject the path wrapped in bracketed-paste markers (ESC[200~ … ESC[201~) so Claude Code's paste handler fires and renders [Image N]. Recommended.
Insert the bare path with terminal.sendText (legacy behaviour — Claude usually will NOT render it inline). For debugging only.
claudeImagePaste.insertionMode.description: How the image path is delivered to the terminal.

claudeImagePaste.cleanupAfterDays.description: Best-effort delete of previously pasted images older than this many days (0 = never delete).
